messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-12-15] standup/cinder/2025-12-15: Team change: Diego leaves team Cinder and joins team Ember, effective today. With Diego moving on, Yuki is on call for the Cinder team from today.

- [2025-01-16] standup/cinder/2025-01-16: Diego Alvarez takes the first the Cinder team on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-10-02] standup/cinder/2025-10-02: On-call rotation: Yuki is primary for team Cinder starting today; Diego is off rotation.
- [2025-11-25] standup/cinder/2025-11-25: Team Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-01-23] standup/ember/2026-01-23: Team Ember on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-02-17] standup/cinder/2025-02-17: Reminder from the Cinder team: page Yuki Tanaka for anything this cycle, not Diego.
- [2026-05-13] standup/ember/2026-05-13: Diego has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar.

- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02: Yuki picked up the Cinder on-call shift from Diego today.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29: Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-02-13] handover/2025-02-13-feature-flags: Handover: as of today the flags service moves from team Atlas to the Cinder team. Priya walked Diego through the runbook this morning.
- [2026-06-17] standup/ember/2026-06-17: Oskar picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego Alvarez today.
- [2025-03-27] standup/cinder/2025-03-27: Rotation day for Cinder: Yuki hands the pager to Diego Alvarez.
- [2026-03-16] standup/ember/2026-03-16: Oskar has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Diego Alvarez. Ember noticed that search-indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: From today the pager for the event-bus rings the Boreal team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-12-15] handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction: The 2025-11-18 note about the indexer named the wrong team. The Dune team took it over on that date; the Ember team did not.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer: Ownership change: the search indexer now sits with the Boreal team. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2026-01-20] handover/2026-01-20-image-resizer: From today the pager for the resizer rings team Dune, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-09] standup/dune/2025-01-09: Team Dune is a one-person team at the moment: Farah.
- [2026-01-14] standup/dune/2026-01-14: Reminder: Tomasz is on call for team Dune this cycle.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-reporting: Ownership change: the reports pipeline now sits with team Ember. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-07-18] handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-07-01: auth-gateway went to team Boreal, not the Cinder team. Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-04-23] standup/dune/2025-04-23: Team Dune adopted a monthly game day.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17: Team change: Marcus leaves Boreal and joins the Atlas team, effective today. Boreal saw that the resizer's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: Team Dune owns the reporting service.
- [2025-01-06] standup/atlas/2025-01-06: Team Atlas this year is Priya and Tomasz.
- [2026-04-06] handover/2026-04-06-notifier: Handover: as of today the notifier moves from the Cinder team to team Boreal. Yuki walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-07-01] handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway: Quick one: the auth gateway belongs to team Cinder starting today. Thanks to the Ember team for running it until now.
- [2025-07-21] standup/atlas/2025-07-21-2: Team Atlas has moved to the second floor.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09: First on-call rotation for the Atlas team goes to Tomasz.
- [2025-11-19] handover/2025-11-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-07-16] standup/atlas/2025-07-16: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-webhooks: The webhook dispatcher has a new home: Dune. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2026-04-29] handover/2026-04-29-ledger: Cinder is taking over the ledger from team Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
